_comment: True and false positives from gitleaks v8.30.1: the tps and fps lists each rule in cmd/generate/config/rules/*.go passes to utils.Validate, dumped from a run of that release's config generator (a patched Validate wrote them out as it ran). Gitleaks asserts every tp yields a finding and every fp none, with the rule's entropy, allowlists and the global allowlist applied. Rules gated on a file path (freemius-secret-key, hashicorp-tf-password, kubernetes-secret-yaml, nuget-config-password, pkcs12-file) are left out because log text has no path. The vectors are credential-shaped, and GitHub push protection rejects them in clear, so `data` is the JSON {rule id: {tp: [...], fp: [...]}} compressed with zlib and base64-encoded in 76 character lines.
